task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/base.wav already loaded as the first track (a 3-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV). Import /home/user/Music/overlay.wav (a 3-second mono 44.1 kHz WAV) as a second track. Mix the two tracks together and export the result to /home/user/Music/mixed.wav as a stereo 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV file.
task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/base.wav already loaded as the first track (a 3-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV).

Import a second file into the same project as an additional track: use File > Import > Audio... and select /home/user/Music/overlay.wav. After importing, the project should have two stereo audio tracks.

Now export the full mixed audio using File > Export > Export as WAV... to /home/user/Music/mixed.wav. Keep the default WAV (Microsoft) signed 16-bit PCM settings. If a metadata-tag dialog appears, click OK to accept the defaults.
